$comment: MESSAGING MODULE (pack: messaging) — targets bizapps-secure-messaging (baseline V202607201423, schema __mj_BizAppsSecureMessaging, entity prefix 'MJ_BizApps_SecureMessaging: ', published by Ian 2026-07-21; in scope per Barnatt 2026-07-22). Threads DERIVE from issues — support conversations get a secure channel — and every hero-authored issue always gets one (cross-app footprint). ContactID/PersonID are SOFT references in their schema (no cross-schema FK), so our deterministic person UUIDs land cleanly. Generated slice: SecureThread/SecureMessage/PortalSession (a session per thread — SecureMessage.PortalSessionID is NOT NULL). NOT generated, by design: PortalMagicLink (runtime auth artifact — fabricating it would be wrong) and MessageFile/FileRequest (need real file blobs).
